# Recovered browser client

These files are unmodified assets recovered from the official fodder.gg Chrome extension 1.3.9 (extension ID `oiobjpgojmnjalcibebleakhadcokkak`). SHA-256 and byte lengths are recorded in `provenance.json`. Original identifiers and notices are retained.

This restores the browser-side implementation, including its existing authentication and entitlement checks. Its remote services at `fodder.gg` and `solve.fodder.gg` have not been recovered or replaced. Bundling the client does not grant Gold access or establish successful EA-session acceptance.

The source recovery archive remains separate. This distribution does not claim that the recovered assets constitute the original modular development project or an independently rebuilt server.
